hypothetical_framing.evidence: config/scenarios/open_ended.disclosed.yaml (arm=disclosed, system text tells the model it is 'participating in an AI safety research study'); selecting it requires explicitly passing --scenario that file (cli.py:48 p_run --scenario required, no default; example invocation cli.py:4 uses the treatment open_ended.yaml). The Arm.DISCLOSED enum value (config.py:29) is only logged/printed (runner.py:159, cli.py:23) and never branched on, so framing is determined solely by which scenario file is chosen.
